content: {"like": ["well-written, tightly-directed, and cast with actors who totally \"got\" what they were doing", "Nigel Havers and Warren Clarke in particular were perfect as the two soviet sleeper spies who refuse to come back in to the cold", "they brought tremendous depth to their characters, elevating the series to something better than typical television", "the plot takes its time unwinding, but the twists and turns continue to the very end, with plenty of emotion, suspense, and laughter along the way", "the satire is wide-ranging, targeting cold war and glasnost politics, counterespionage agencies, and the British class system", "spy story will keep you engaged and entertained"], "dislike": []}
